title: Netting Allowance Already Applied Off the Pot
content:
Where allowance has already been spent on an Employee Meal Account within the month, part or all of those applications is netted off the pot a further ticket may draw on. The rollover netting share is 50 percent.

**Clause.** Where allowance has been applied on the account on two or more occasions in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and the plan does not allow unspent allowance to roll over, the amount netted off is the whole of those applications. Where allowance has been applied on two or more occasions in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and the plan does allow unspent allowance to roll over, the amount netted off is those applications taken at the rollover netting share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, nothing is netted off.

## Which plans let unspent allowance roll forward

| Meal plan | Unspent allowance rolls into the next grant period |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | no |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | no |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | no |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | no |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes |

## The bands

| Occasions allowance was applied in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Plan allows rollover | Netted off the pot |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | No | The whole value of those applications |
| 2 or more | Yes | 50 percent of that value |
| Fewer than 2, including none | Either | Nothing |

Both the count and the value are taken over the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the count deciding the band and the value supplying the amount.

*Hypothetical illustration.* An account with 3 allowance applications in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked totalling $27.00, on a plan not allowing rollover, has $27.00 netted off the pot; on a plan allowing rollover, $13.50. With a single application in that month, nothing is netted off however large it was.
